p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_parse.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"data/size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary file that becomes the parser input."},{"step":2,"file":"src/isomedia/isom_intern.c","function":"gf_isom_open_file","line":782,"var":"fileName","code":"movie = gf_isom_new_movie(); mov->fileName = gf_strdup(fileName);","note":"The temporary file path is opened as an ISO movie and the parser state is initialized for reading."},{"step":3,"file":"src/isomedia/box_code_apple.c","function":"ilst_item_box_read","line":143,"var":"sub_type","code":"sub_type = gf_bs_peek_bits(bs, 32, 4);","note":"The parser distinguishes the iTunes data-box layout from the QuickTime fallback based on attacker-controlled bytes."},{"step":4,"file":"src/isomedia/box_code_apple.c","function":"ilst_item_box_read","line":145,"var":"a","code":"e = gf_isom_box_parse_ex(&a, bs, s->type, GF_FALSE);","note":"A nested data box is parsed from the input and its size is derived from the crafted box header."},{"step":5,"file":"src/isomedia/box_code_apple.c","function":"ilst_item_box_read","line":149,"var":"ptr->data","code":"if (a->size > 4 && (a->type != GF_ISOM_BOX_TYPE_VOID)) { ptr->data = (GF_DataBox *)a; }","note":"The parsed data box is retained in ptr->data so later code will treat it as the active item payload."},{"step":6,"file":"src/isomedia/box_code_apple.c","function":"ilst_item_box_read","line":165,"var":"ptr->data->data","code":"gf_bs_read_data(bs, ptr->data->data, ptr->data->dataSize);","note":"In the QuickTime-style branch, the attacker-controlled length is copied into the allocated data buffer; if the length exceeds the destination object size, this becomes the crashing write sink."}]')
print(p.read_text())
